name: ont-063-fixture-shop
description: e2e fixture for case-insensitive model-name resolution: a Prisma SQLite source whose models are Customer -> Order plus a Payment table an operator would type as `payment`, the way psql spells it. Three models is the minimum that lets the scenario refuse one by the wrong casing, keep two, and still narrow with --models. Copied into a scratch run dir under .docs/scratch by the e2e; bare imports in generated code resolve via the monorepo-root node_modules walk-up. No database is needed — every claim is read off generated bytes, the recorded baseline, and CLI exit codes.
